entities.name: Shanghai Urban Planning Exhibition Center
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Shanghai Urban Planning Exhibition Center is located on People's Square, Shanghai, adjacent to the municipal government building. It was China's first city planning exhibition hall and similar halls later became common in major cities and new towns in China.
